answer_1.quote: We evaluate IPA on a diverse range of tasks: toxicity reduction ( §4.1), lexically constrained generation ( §4. 2), open-ended generation ( §4.3), dialogue safety control ( §4.4), and knowledge-grounded dialogue ( §4.5).
answer_1.outputs: fluent continuation, safe response, constrained text, coherent dialogue, faithful response

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use aggregate n-gram diversity and coherence scores  as well as MAUVE , which measures the distribution similarity between the set of human-written and machine-generated texts.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluations; see Appendix A.1 for more details.
answer_4.guideline: human evaluation of safety and coherence (3-point Likert scale), pairwise comparisons on coherence and fluency using AMT, quality and plausibility of model generations based on a 3-point Likert Scale
